high_level_description: The image depicts a woman standing on a red carpet at an event hosted by the "National Board of Review." She is wearing a strapless black gown with intricate detailing, including sequins or beads that add a shimmering effect to the fabric. The dress fits closely to her body, accentuating her figure. She has long, dark hair styled straight and falls over her shoulders. Her makeup is elegant, featuring a natural look with a focus on her eyes and lips. The backdrop behind her is white with the words "NATIONAL BOARD OF REVIEW" repeated multiple times in a bold, sans-serif font.
